{{Top|leg}}
The '''Bakuran Senate Chamber''' was located in the [[Bakur Memorial Building]] in [[Salis D'aar/Legends|Salis D'aar]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]]. It was rectangular in shape, with [[Repulsorlift chair/Legends|repulsor chairs]] to accommodate all forty of Bakura's [[Senator/Legends|senators]]. Senior Senators sat on the lower levels, while Junior Senators were further back. During the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] rule of the planet, [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Wilek Nereus]] sat in a repulsor chair at the front of the room, positioned effectively like a throne.
